property_summary: For any admissible initialize parameters, after a successful initialize the pool's baseToken getter must equal the supplied _baseToken; the mutant never assigns baseToken so it stays address(0) and violates this for any nonzero _baseToken.

After any successful initialize(_baseToken,...) call, c.baseToken() must equal the _baseToken argument passed in; the mutant sets baseToken to _nft instead, violating this whenever _baseToken != _nft.
After any successful initialize call, c.baseToken() must equal the _baseToken argument passed in; the mutant always stores address(0), so it breaks whenever a nonzero base token is initialized.
m_diagnostic: testFuzz_property(address,address,uint128,uint128,uint56,uint16,bytes32,bool,bool): baseToken must equal the initialized base token: 0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000000 != 0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000648

property_summary: After a successful initialize with base token b, c.flashFeeToken() (which reads c.baseToken()) must equal b for every admissible input; the mutant always stores address(0), so it violates this for any nonzero b.
For any admissible initialization, c.nft() must equal the _nft parameter passed to initialize; the mutant never stores _nft, leaving nft as address(0) for some inputs.

After a successful initialize(_baseToken, _nft, ...), contract C must store the NFT address verbatim so that c.nft() == _nft for every input; the mutant stores _baseToken instead, so any call with _nft != _baseToken yields c.nft() != _nft.
For any admissible non-zero _nft passed to initialize, the pool must store it: c.nft() == _nft; the buggy version stores address(0), breaking the rule for any non-zero input.

After initialize completes on any admissible input, the stored changeFee must equal the _changeFee argument passed in; the mutant never writes changeFee, so it stays 0 and mismatches for any nonzero _changeFee.

After initialize completes, the stored changeFee must exactly equal the _changeFee passed in (for any _changeFee < 2**56-1), but the mutant stores _changeFee + 1 and so violates this for every admissible input.
After initialize(...) with any fee rate <= 5000 completes, c.feeRate() must equal the supplied _feeRate; the mutant never assigns feeRate, so it stays 0 and violates this for any nonzero fee rate.
For any admissible fee rate (<= 5000), initialize stores exactly that rate so c.feeRate() equals the requested _feeRate; the mutant stores _feeRate + 1, violating this for every input.
